description: Create a GitHub issue for an Average Rent bug, feature request, or other feedback the user asks to submit. Send only the title and description they approve. Do not include private account data or conversation history. Returns the issue link. Requires feedback:write and uses no rent-data calls.

category.description: Feedback type: bug, feature, or other. Defaults to other.

description.description: Feedback text approved by the user, up to 8000 characters. Include the problem, expected result, and steps when known. Exclude private data.

title.description: Short issue title approved by the user, from 1 to 160 characters on one line.

name: report_feedback
title: Report feedback
